 Social Security Column: 3.6% benefit increase for 2027 
 By Amy Long
Social Security Administration 
 Nov 14, 2026 
 21 hrs ago 
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 Social Security benefits and Supplemental Security Income payments for 76 million Americans will increase 3.6% in 2027. On average, Social Security retirement benefits will increase by about $75 per month in January. Nearly 72 million Social Security beneficiaries will see a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment in January. Increased payments to about 7.3 million people receiving SSI will begin on Dec. 31.
 Several other adjustments that take effect in January of each year are based on increases in average wages. For example, the maximum amount of earnings subject to the Social Security tax, known as taxable maximum, is slated to increase to $192,300 from $184,500 in 2027.
